scope: Local adult API, Firebase Auth and Firestore emulators; synthetic accounts only, no real AI or publication.

checks.name: adult accounts can invite and accept a private conversation
concurrent retries create one message and increment unread count once
an outsider cannot write to the private conversation
recipient revocation blocks delivery and leaves metadata unchanged
closed recipient is rejected even if its profile still exists
a prior child relationship cannot reuse an approved adult chat
blocking a sender immediately prevents another message
after an explicit unblock the legitimate message works again
sender access is rechecked for the next request
